description: This file defines the EmailSubscriptionService class within the OrangeHRM Admin Service namespace. It provides a method to access an EmailSubscriptionDao instance, implementing lazy initialization. The class acts as a service layer component for managing email subscriptions in the HRM system.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionService
